title: Tour: Media Storage
blurb: One home for your images, videos and documents.

steps.title: Open Media Storage
steps.body: Click **Media Storage** in the left menu. Your images, videos and documents live here.

steps.title: Upload
steps.body: **Upload** adds files from your computer. You can also drag files straight onto the page.

steps.title: Folders
steps.body: Use folders to keep things tidy, like Logos, Job photos or Price lists.

steps.title: Views and search
steps.body: Switch between grid and list view, sort by name, size or date, and search across every folder.

steps.title: Trash
steps.body: Deleted files go to **Trash** for 30 days, so you can get them back.

steps.title: What's next
steps.body: Next: try **Upload files to Media Storage** from the Guide.
